title: Coherent coefficient comparisons commute with ambient exchange
statement: For any coherent integral-residue pull comparison family [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface], any commutative scheme square and any integral derived complex K, the natural square comparing reduction of ambient integral exchange and ambient residue exchange using the pull comparisons and their actual push mates commutes. This assertion requires no invertibility of push mates, no constructibility, and no geometric finiteness.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Equality transport of morphisms commutes with pull coefficient comparison, by substitution. The two pull composition equations therefore give the commuting pull-square cube after cancellation of the composition isomorphisms.

Apply coefficient_exchange_of_counit_at to the four actual derived adjunctions and the two ambient exchange components at K and its reduction. The ambient exchange counit identities and actual push mate counit identities supply its hypotheses; the pull cube is needed only at the integral direct image of K.
